prompt: What does an illuminated steady yellow traffic light require an approaching driver to do in Texas?

options.text: Accelerate immediately to pass through the intersection before the red
Come to a complete stop inside the crosswalk area and wait for green
Shift into reverse and return to the previous street traffic block
Stop safely before entering; if unable to stop safely, proceed with caution

svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 180" class="w-full max-h-48 rounded-xl bg-[#F0F2EF] border border-[#D9DDD8]">
            <!-- Traffic Signal 1: Flashing Red -->
            <g transform="translate(100, 20)">
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="50" height="120" rx="10" fill="#18181B" stroke="#71717A" stroke-width="2" />
              <!-- Red glowing light -->
              <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="16" fill="#DC2626" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" />
              <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="22" fill="#DC2626" opacity="0.35" />
              <circle cx="25" cy="60" r="14" fill="#3F3F46" />

              <text x="-24" y="144" fill="#EF4444" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">FLASHING RED = STOP</text>
            </g>

            <g transform="translate(270, 20)">

              <circle cx="25" cy="60" r="16" fill="#FBBF24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" />

              <circle cx="25" cy="95" r="14" fill="#3F3F46" />

              <text x="-22" y="144" fill="#FBBF24" font-family="'JetBrains Mono', monospace" font-size="8" font-weight="bold">FLASH YELLOW = CAUTION</text>
            </g>
          </svg>
